infoLinks.content:
There are delays on route 34 train services due to temporary speed restrictions.
This service is delayed  due to the late arrival of the XPT from Sydney caused rail restrictive rail speeds.
Plan ahead and allow extra travel time.

infoLinks.content:
At John Street Square Light Rail Lift between Harris St and the Light Rail stop is temporarily out of service.
For your safety, do not use even if doors open.
 
Alternative access:
•	Use the stairs,
•        Or use the lift on the opposite platform
 
For urgent assistance:
•	Use the Help Point if on the platform
•        Or call 131 500
